message.content: {"note_claim": "Congress explicitly granted the executive branch authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) under 8 U.S.C. 1254a.", "label": "SUPPORTS", "quote": "The Attorney General, after consultation with appropriate agencies of the Government, may designate any foreign state (or any part of such foreign state) under this subsection only if", "reason": "The statute text itself gives the executive branch (Attorney General, now DHS) the authority to designate, terminate, or extend TPS designations, and bars judicial review of those determinations, which substantiates the note's first claim."}

parsed.note_claim: Congress explicitly granted the executive branch authority to designate, extend, or terminate Temporary Protected Status (TPS) under 8 U.S.C. 1254a.
parsed.label: SUPPORTS
parsed.quote: The Attorney General, after consultation with appropriate agencies of the Government, may designate any foreign state (or any part of such foreign state) under this subsection only if
parsed.reason: The statute text itself gives the executive branch (Attorney General, now DHS) the authority to designate, terminate, or extend TPS designations, and bars judicial review of those determinations, which substantiates the note's first claim.
